counterfactual.change: Removed the single detector_fail event on N (events -> []); same 686 steps. Predicted removal restores NS max-out/gap-out so EW gets green and max_wait disappears.

explanation: NS green starts ~490 and is still held at 686 (~196 s) despite max_green_seconds=87. The detector_fail on N (t=562, dur 164, zero-arrival approach with queue 0) blinds the actuated controller to N's empty queue, so the 'own detectors see no queue' gap-out never becomes true, and the max-out/recall path also fails to fire. NS therefore holds green while S keeps discharging and E/W starve (wait 77 at 562 -> 90 at 575 -> 200 at 685 -> 201 at 686), violating max_wait.

violation.detail: approach 1 has waited 201 s at red with vehicles queued (limit 200)

vision_note: The east-west approaches stay stopped at red with long queues of waiting vehicles while the north-south direction holds green. Steps 683 through 686 look identical with no movement of the starved queues, showing the signal is stuck.
